leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a function that accepts an array, a reducer callback, and an initial value
Initialize an accumulator variable using the provided initial value
Iterate through each element of the array using a loop
Apply the reducer callback to update the accumulator with each element
Return the final accumulator value after processing all elements
Configure the function to handle cases where no initial value is provided
Integrate the custom reduce polyfill into a test script to verify its behavior
